interface.longDescription: This legacy name exposes the same generic quality surface as Craft Quality. It evaluates versioned Subjects with frozen cases, calibrated graders, repeated trials, and evidence-backed promotion decisions without automatic publication.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate this Skill candidate against its frozen baseline and report eligible, rejected, or inconclusive.
